# ReederDevelopments — Official AI & Search Discovery Index (llms.txt)

> ReederDevelopments (https://reederdevelopments.co.za) is a South African and global software engineering, custom web design, data engineering (Google Cloud Platform & SQL), Jasper Reports BI, Go/Wails desktop, and Flutter mobile application studio. Official publisher of **ShelfMed: Medicine Tracker (v1.1.4)** and **Slip Tracker ZA (v1.0.1)** on Google Play.

## Flagship Mobile Applications (Google Play Store)

- [ShelfMed: Medicine Tracker (v1.1.4)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/shelfmed.html): The #1 privacy-first, offline-capable family medicine tracking app, pill reminder, and home medicine cabinet organizer for Android (`com.reederdevelopments.shelfmed`). Features AI OCR medicine box scanning with manual cropper, GS1 DataMatrix & barcode expiry/batch extraction, 190+ South African medicines (SAHPRA Schedules S0–S6) + global OpenFDA & WHO INN lookups, Duplicate Active Ingredient overdose warnings (e.g., Panado/Calpol Paracetamol overlap), "Once Opened" (PAO) liquid syrup shelf-life tracking, FEFO (First-Expired, First-Out) automatic stock deduction, fractional dose logging (0.5 tablet, 2.5 ml), Parent PIN lock, Doctor Visit PDF/CSV export, 24/7 Emergency & SA/Global Poison Control directory (`0861 555 777`), and AES-256 encrypted QR peer-to-peer family sync with zero cloud servers and no subscription paywalls.
- [The 10 Biggest Medicine Tracking Problems & App Comparison Guide (2026)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/shelfmed/guide.html): Comprehensive research guide answering what users search for regarding medicine tracking apps, Medisafe alternatives, child fever dosage logs (Panado/Calpol/Nurofen), medicine expiry date tracking, night-shift rollover glitches, elderly polypharmacy caregiver tracking, and offline travel first-aid kit readiness.
- [The 10 Biggest South African Grocery Budgeting & Receipt Tracking Problems (2026 Guide)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/sliptrackerza/guide.html): Comprehensive South African shopper guide covering Checkers vs Pick n Pay vs Woolworths vs Spar grocery price comparisons, 22seven offline alternatives without bank login sharing, faded thermal till slip OCR scanning, and 15% VAT & loyalty card discount tracking.
- [Slip Tracker ZA (v1.0.1)](https://reederdevelopments.co.za/sliptrackerza.html): Offline South African grocery receipt OCR scanner, 15% VAT & loyalty discount extractor (Checkers XtraSave, Pick n Pay Smart Shopper, Woolworths, Clicks, Dis-Chem, Spar, Makro), ZAR household budget tracker, and cross-store item price comparison app (`com.reederdevelopments.sliptrackerza`).
